commitMessage:
Bug 521254 - [9] Update remaining invocations to deprecated
IClassFile#getType()

Change-Id: I24a5b92d3a62be24cbd5f7ceee7cad5362024021
Signed-off-by: Kalyan Prasad Tatavarthi <kalyan_prasad@in.ibm.com>
dslRule:
/*!
<!id: deprecation.iPackageFragment.getClassFile>
<!description: Replace deprecated IPackageFragment.getClassFile() with IPackageFragment.getOrdinaryClassFile() (Java 9+). IOrdinaryClassFile is a subtype of IClassFile, ensuring backward compatibility in assignments where only IClassFile is expected.>
<!severity: WARNING>
*/
org.eclipse.jdt.core.IPackageFragment.getClassFile($arg$) :: sourceVersionGE(9)
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.core.IPackageFragment.getOrdinaryClassFile($arg$)
;;

commitMessage:
Bug 521254 - [9] Update remaining invocations to deprecated
IClassFile#getType()

Change-Id: I24a5b92d3a62be24cbd5f7ceee7cad5362024021
Signed-off-by: Kalyan Prasad Tatavarthi <kalyan_prasad@in.ibm.com>
dslRule:
/*!
<!id: eclipse.jdt.core.ipackagefragment.getordinaryclassfile>
<!description: Replace deprecated IPackageFragment.getClassFile() with getOrdinaryClassFile() and update the variable type.
This addresses the deprecation of IClassFile in favor of IOrdinaryClassFile for non-modular class files, introduced in Java 9.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: deprecated, java9-migration, eclipse>
*/
org.eclipse.jdt.core.IClassFile $classFile = $pack.getClassFile($args$); :: sourceVersionGE(9) && instanceof($pack, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IPackageFragment")
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.core.IOrdinaryClassFile $classFile = $pack.getOrdinaryClassFile($args$);
;;
